The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sanorn''' earned the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He worked on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Vaiken Spacedock]], which was located within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]], where he sold equipment during the war to other Imperials. Working alongside other [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] in the supplies section of the station, Sanorn wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] and white set of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] including a mask while working.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sanorn was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as an Imperial classic gear vendor within the Imperial fleet, and appears again in the same room as a Basic Gear vendor. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
